answer_4.quote: We conducted human annotations to evaluate summaries generated by different models trained with 1% (147) conversations from SAMSum. Specifically, we asked annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk 5 to rank summaries via a 1 (the most preferred) to 3 (the least preferred) scale, generated from BART, CODA and Semi-CODA for randomly sampled 150 conversations.
